summary: Verified the new mandatory DonationAlerts phrase feature and the admin 'Проверочное сообщение' Telegram test button. Isolated pytest suite tests/test_support_payments.py: 6/6 pass (includes the money-safe 'da:test:*' handler test and phrase-no-repeat-in-5 unit test over 200 issues). Live suite tests/test_admin_telegram_test_msg.py against the public preview URL: 10/10 pass (401/403 without admin token, admin login works, webhook 403 without secret / 200 with sha256[:48] secret, and 5 parametrised 'da:test:{ask,ok,rej,no,amt}' callbacks verified via /api/telegram/webhook do NOT create deposits or change balances — deposits count and total user balance snapshot before/after are identical, no phantom test0000... deposit is materialised). New live suite tests/test_live_da_phrases.py: 5/5 pass — the /api/donationalerts/requests response phrase is always in backend/da_phrases.py PHRASES (60 entries), the da_instructions chat message carries a top-level `phrase` field equal to the response and step 4 of its text contains the exact phrase, the Mongo deposit doc has da_phrase and description contains «phrase», and issuing 35 alternating DA requests (rejecting each before the next) never repeats a phrase within the previous 5 issued and never collides with the phrase of another still-pending DA request. Pressed /api/admin/telegram/test with a valid admin bearer exactly ONCE — returned {ok:true}. UI on /admin -> Чаты: admin-telegram-card visible with 'Подключён к этому сайту' status and admin-telegram-test button labelled 'Проверочное сообщение'. UI on the P2 support chat (RU): DonationAlerts instruction message renders donation-phrase block with 'СООБЩЕНИЕ ДЛЯ ДОНАТА — НАЖМИТЕ, ЧТОБЫ СКОПИРОВАТЬ' header and «phrase» value, plus step 4 of the instructions contains the phrase; PlayerPanel line for a DA deposit format is '«{da_phrase}»' (fallback to da_code only if phrase missing). English label 'Donation message — tap to copy' exists in frontend/src/lib/ui-i18n.js (da.phrase_label). Money-safety code (deposit_settlement / bank / spin / drop) NOT modified. Test DonationAlerts deposits created during the run were set to status='cancelled', tg_notified=true so the retry loop does not message the owner.
critical_code_review_comments: da_phrases.pick_phrase does not consider deposits with status 'cancelled' or 'rejected' as 'taken'; that is deliberate (only the sliding window of the last 5 by created_at plus currently-pending ones are excluded). Current behaviour matches the requirement.
server.py is still ~2987 lines — modularising chats/deposits/admin routes remains a nice-to-have from previous iterations, non-blocking.
test_credentials: Admin seed 'alpha bravo charlie delta echo foxtrot golf hotel india juliet'. User1 token /root/logs/token.txt (discord_test_1, sv=3). User2 token /root/logs/token2.txt (discord_test_2, sv=0). Telegram webhook secret = sha256(f'{TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}:{JWT_SECRET}').hexdigest()[:48].
seed_data_creation: During the phrase-repeat test 35 DonationAlerts requests were created for discord_test_1/discord_test_2 and immediately marked rejected in Mongo. All test DA deposits (pending or otherwise) for these two users were then set to status='cancelled' with tg_notified=true so the Telegram retry loop stays quiet.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live suites: python -m pytest -m live tests/test_admin_telegram_test_msg.py tests/test_live_da_phrases.py -n 0 (needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env, tokens in /root/logs/token{,2}.txt). test_live_da_phrases.py has an autouse fixture that cancels any leftover pending DA deposits for discord_test_1/2 before AND after each test so results are deterministic and the owner does not get real Telegram messages. Do NOT press /api/admin/telegram/test more than once per run — this iteration already sent one. Do NOT call /api/admin/telegram/setup. The da_phrases 60-entry catalog is authoritative.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end. Sliding window in da_phrases.pick_phrase looks at the last 5 deposits by created_at with a da_phrase field and additionally excludes phrases of currently 'pending' DA deposits; verified over 200 unit issues and 35 live issues.
